import sys

def rectangleArea(length, breadth):
    return length * breadth

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # Assuming at least two integers are provided
    length = int(data[0])
    breadth = int(data[1]) if len(data) > 1 else 0
    area = rectangleArea(length, breadth)
    print(area)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
